question:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question the follows.

The bar-graph shows the distance (in km) between two cities and speeds (in km/h) of a person to cover the respective distances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7cc3d1f9a7febe475d8ac86ac2184a08498bbfb829894cda6b41fd34745b77.png] 

What is the approximate average speed of the person while travelling from city A to city F?
solution:
**Given:**

The bar graph representing the distance between two cities and the speed of person to cover the distance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7cc3d1f9a7febe475d8ac86ac2184a08498bbfb829894cda6b41fd34745b77.png] 

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/speed

**Calculations:**

Time taken in covering the distance A-B is

= 80/16 = 5
